comment: polyself.c dogaze() 1677: a monster that died after the last movemon() is still on fmon when the hero gazes, and dogaze() skips it. A debug Valkyrie quaffs two blessed potions of gain energy for the 15 Pw a gaze costs, drops her gear, polymorphs into a pyrolisk (fire gaze), quaffs a blessed potion of speed so that her next action follows the once-per-turn block, creates a sleeping newt, steps away and reads a cursed scroll of stinking cloud centred on it. run_regions() kills the newt ('You kill it!'); dmonsfree() has not run, so #monster's fmon loop meets the dead newt (1677) before 'You gaze at no place in particular.'
